caption: Ctrl+X with only a cursor in the paragraph: the paragraph stays, and a notice says why.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach(n => n.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.focus(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const before=e.getValue(); e.setCursor({line:6,ch:20}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); document.execCommand('cut'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); if (e.getValue()!==before) throw new Error('the line was cut: '+e.getValue()); const n=[...document.querySelectorAll('.notice')].map(x=>x.textContent).join('|'); if (!n.includes('did not cut the line')) throw new Error('no notice: '+n); return n; })()

caption: The two commands for a line cut or copy on purpose. Give them a hotkey in Settings, Hotkeys.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach(n => n.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.focus(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); e.setCursor({line:6,ch:0}); app.commands.executeCommandById('command-palette:open'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const i=document.querySelector('.prompt-input'); if (!i) throw new Error('no palette'); i.value='selection or line'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-item')].map(x=>x.textContent).join('|'); if (!t.includes('Cut selection or line') || !t.includes('Copy selection or line')) throw new Error('commands: '+t); return t; })()

caption: Pro: with the second press mode, the first Ctrl+X only shows this hint. Press again within 2 seconds to cut the line.
eval: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['line-cut-guard']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('line-cut-guard-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); p.settings.cut='twice'; p.applySettings(); document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach(n => n.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.focus(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const before=e.getValue(); e.setCursor({line:6,ch:20}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); document.execCommand('cut'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); if (e.getValue()!==before) throw new Error('cut on the first press'); const n=[...document.querySelectorAll('.notice')].map(x=>x.textContent).join('|'); if (!n.includes('again')) throw new Error('no hint: '+n); return n; })()
after: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['line-cut-guard']; p.settings.cut='block'; p.pro.signOut(); p.applySettings(); document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach(n => n.remove()); return 'ok'; })()
